reviewer_name_or_role: AI-assisted evidence audit — not practitioner approval
experience_basis: Current course-data audit against QSC, Neutrik, Belden and Stagehand cable-handling research
equipment_jurisdiction_context: General flexible production-cable handling; no technical connection/testing authority
findings: The course is structurally sound when over-under remains a common compatible-cable method rather than a universal cable rule. Cable ownership/release, manufacturer limits and department authority must remain explicit.

reviewer_name_or_role: AI-assisted evidence audit — not field-observer/practitioner approval
experience_basis: Crew Blueprint authority-state architecture plus assessment-validity review
equipment_jurisdiction_context: Observed practice on a named cable only
findings: Separating knowledge completion from observed practice is appropriate. Any field-observation rubric must name the cable family/method/conditions and must not imply transfer to sensitive cable families or employer authorization.

reviewer_name_or_role: AI-assisted media audit — not practitioner visual approval
experience_basis: Current AI-generated sequence compared with the text/evidence scope
findings: The existing AI visual may remain owner-review material because the text fallback is complete and the claim is low-to-moderate risk, but a competent practitioner should review the depiction before publication-ready status. It must not imply one required hand position or universal cable applicability.
